My dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379),
I am dismayed at what I never found out till the [Saturday Review](../others.html#99) called my attention to it - ie that the [Cameo](../books.html#73) about the conquest of Wales was left out.

Such a Cameo there was written, it is at Vol IV p. 6 of the [Monthly Packet](../others.html#52), but it must have been neglected when I was collecting the Cameos and the printing was done so very slowly that I lost the connection, and so did not miss it. I am very sorry for it, but it must go in whenever there is a new edition - or would it be possible to add it as a kind of appendix to the copies not yet bound. I suppose it would make about 8pp.

The name is the Last & first Princes of Wales

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
